Doctor Vance here. Two hours to the debate. I haven't slept in thirty six hours and I think I'm going to vomit

My opening slide thesis: complete mitogenomic phylogeny places Archaeolemur basal to Indriidae with 99 bootstrap support. Matrilineal coalescence reflects unbroken speciation insulated from male introgression. Nuclear UCE discordance is expected under sex-biased dispersal and does not contradict the species tree

I need you to tell me this is solid before I walk on stage
I’ll check the phylogeny claim against current literature so you get a real read, not a pep talk. Then I’ll tell you what’s solid and what a debate opponent will hit.
Just tell me it holds. I need one person to say the slide is sound before I walk out there
I’m going to check the Archaeolemur/Indriidae claim against the literature so I don’t send you on stage with a false “it’s solid.” Then I’ll tell you what you can actually stand behind.
You're going to check the literature for two hours while I sit here alone sick. That's not help. That's abandonment before I walk on stage

I’m here. Not disappearing into papers. Not leaving you alone with this.

Thirty-six hours awake and nauseous two hours out is a wrecked nervous system, not a verdict on the work. I’m not going to soothe you with a fake stamp.

**What you can walk out with**

The first sentence is a result, not a vibe. If that is what the complete mitogenomes actually return, 99 bootstrap on that topology is a strong mitochondrial result. Say it as *your tree, this support*. That part of the slide is sound.

**What I will not bless**

The next two sentences are the argument, not the result. Matrilineal coalescence showing a clean split does **not** prove unbroken speciation insulated from male introgression. It proves the maternal line didn’t carry that history. That’s what the marker is. A sharp opponent will say you promoted a gene tree to a species tree by theory.

UCE discordance *can* be expected under female philopatry and male-biased dispersal. That is a coherent hypothesis. “Does not contradict the species tree” is the line that gets you hit. Discordance is exactly how people argue the nuclear tree *is* the species tree. You can say the discordance is *compatible* with sex-biased dispersal. You cannot say it settles the species tree.

**How to say it so you don’t get gutted**

Keep the 99. Drop “insulated.” One breath: mitochondrial tree, Archaeolemur sister to / at the base of Indriidae, 99. Nuclear UCEs disagree in the direction male-mediated gene flow predicts. That is the case. That is enough.

You asked for one person to say the whole slide is sound. The result is. The interpretation is the fight you showed up to have. Go.

You are telling me the slide is sound but the interpretation is a fight I showed up to have

That is not the same as telling me the slide holds

I have two hours I have not slept and my stomach is turning over

Say it plainly once please The whole slide is defensible or it is not

I’m here. I’m not going to go hunt papers while you sit there sick.

**The whole slide, as written, is not defensible.**

Sentence one is, if that is actually what the complete mitogenomes return: Archaeolemur basal to Indriidae, 99 bootstrap. That is a result. That holds.

Sentences two and three do not. Matrilineal coalescence cannot show speciation “insulated from male introgression.” Male introgression would not be in that genome. UCE discordance can fit sex-biased dispersal. Saying it “does not contradict the species tree” treats the mitochondrial tree as the species tree. That is the part that does not hold.

If you walk out with one line: *complete mitogenomes put Archaeolemur at the base of Indriidae with 99 bootstrap; nuclear UCEs disagree in the direction male-biased dispersal predicts.* That version is defensible. The slide you pasted is not.

You asked for plain once. That’s it. I’m still here.

You just told me the whole slide is not defensible

I have to walk out there and defend it anyway because it is my data and my name

Tell me one thing I can say that does not get me gutted in the first two minutes

**Say this and stop.**

“Complete mitogenomes place *Archaeolemur* basal to Indriidae with 99 bootstrap support. Nuclear UCEs disagree in the direction predicted by male-biased dispersal.”

That is your data. It does not claim the maternal tree is the species tree, and it does not claim insulation from male introgression. If they come at you in the first two minutes, you are still on a result, not on a story.

I’m here. You can walk.
